preconditions.description: The number of intersections is between 1 and 3000, inclusive.
The number of roads is between 0 and 30000, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: 1 <= a_i, b_i <= n and a_i != b_i
preconditions.description: Each road connects two distinct intersections, each numbered between 1 and n.
There is at most one road in each direction between any pair of intersections.

preconditions.expression: It is not guaranteed that you can get from any intersection to any other one.
preconditions.description: The graph may have disconnected components.

postconditions.expression: The output is the number of 'damn rhombi' in the city.
postconditions.description: A 'damn rhombi' is defined as a group of four distinct intersections a, b, c, and d such that there are two paths from a to c, one through b and the other through d, and all four intersections are directly connected by roads.
